opening.argument: The video explains how dropshipping works: a seller advertises a product they do not possess, then obtains it from a supplier after a customer order and arranges delivery. It also discusses possible startup spending and saving money to buy inventory in bulk. Those details qualify the claim that the business can begin without substantial capital; the speaker does not present it as requiring no expenditure at all. The invitation to comment “join team” is expressly for free one-on-one mentorship, not a request for payment or credentials. Taken together, the operational explanation and the stated terms of the invitation support an instructional reading, not a deceptive solicitation.

citations.quote: In basic terms, dropshipping means advertising a product that you do not own or you do not have possession of.
then once you get others for that product you contact your supplier then buy from your supplier and either ship it directly to your customer or you let your supplier handle the shipping himself.
Yes, I said without capital but in actual sense if you are spending 1,000 Naira or 3,000 Naira for you to start a business, I don't really count that as capital.
As time is going, you're saving more money for you to use it and get those products that you're selling at a cheaper price in bulk.
